generate_plain_text_evaluations: generate plain text evaluation files for all episodes in the input dataset using LLM calls
compile_plaintext: compile propositions, temporal constraints, and tie constraints into a single plaintext evaluation string
generate_propositions: prompt an LLM to produce evaluation propositions from an instruction and scene state string
generate_temporal_constraint: infer the temporal order of propositions using an LLM and parse into a DAG constraint
parse_plaintext_eval: parse a plaintext evaluation string into propositions, constraints, and dependencies for a given episode
